title: MyBrainSpec
summary: A short cognitive self-check. AI scores it and returns a written profile of how your own attention and memory actually behave.
thesis: A short, structured self-check can surface genuine patterns in a person's own attention and memory — worth reflecting back as a written profile.
experiment: Built a short cognitive self-check app in React/Vite with Firebase; Gemini scores responses and returns a written profile of the user's attention and memory.
question: Can a short self-administered check produce a genuinely useful, personalized profile of how someone's attention and memory actually behave?

mine: Designed a short cognitive self-check covering attention and memory
Built the AI scoring and written-profile generation with Gemini
Built the app in React/Vite with Firebase
